iteration: v136 -- soak test, Qwen3-8B on 2xP150a (39min before hardware crash)

duration.note: Test aimed for 6h but terminated at 39min when container received SIGKILL (exit 137). Root cause: host OOM killer or cgroup limit. After crash, device 0 (PCI 01:00.0) entered permanent SIGBUS state unrecoverable without host reboot. Device 1 recovered via tt-smi -r. Container restarts consistently failed with SIGBUS in libtt_metal.so during mesh_device init. Full PCI remove+rescan+module reload could not recover device 0. Throughput data from the 39-minute window is definitive: zero drift.
